scope: Corollary 7.5 (Polynomial costs and fixed cutoffs) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 106. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Up to radii O(nC) in mesh units, every fixed positive nest weight and each of its fixed real powers has expectation between n−A/C′ and C′nA, for constants depending on the fixed weight and geometry. Changing a cutoff by a fixed factor changes its expectation by a bounded factor. Changing a permitted exterior completion beyond such a fixed buffer, while keeping the patch, buffer, and deterministic wall portions unchanged, does the same. For a fixed weight W, uniformly for t in a fixed compact interval, log EWt+ε − log EWt ≤ C|ε| log n + O(|ε|) when ε stays in a sufficiently small fixed interval.
